fieldValues.title: An affirmed remedy reads as the right one
fieldValues.statement: Once a remedy is affirmed, the flow treats it as the answer. A problem can have many remedies, but I cannot see them side by side, which ones compete, or how they relate, so nothing prompts us to synthesise them into the way forward. A remedy is a hypothesis: it records a falsifier, but not what would count as success, and nothing records whether the experiment has run or what it showed.
